programme.title: Police Aur Mujrim
programme.desc: A gangster is out for blood after his henchmen get locked up by the police. Fueled by vengeance, he's determined to make them pay for their betrayal.

programme.title: Kabzaa
programme.desc: Son of a slain freedom fighter, Air Force officer Arkeshwara sees his life completely derailed by tragedy, forcing him down a dark path into organized crime.

programme.title: Eena Meena Deeka
programme.desc: Deeka, newly released from prison, unexpectedly finds herself in the middle of a bank heist led by the clever Eena. Get ready for a wild ride of twists!

programme.title: Aakhree Raasta
programme.desc: Falsely imprisoned for his wife's murder, a man escapes to seek revenge. But his mission takes an emotional turn when the determined cop chasing him is revealed to be his estranged son.

programme.title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan (1998)
programme.desc: Two police officers, Arjun and Pyare, are wrongly blamed for crimes. Their search for answers leads to a shocking discovery: the criminals look just like them.

programme.title: Shaan
programme.desc: DCP Shiv Kumar's brothers Vijay and Ravi set out to find his killer. Their search leads them to gangster-smuggler Shakal.

programme.title: Andhaa Kanoon
programme.desc: Khan is sentenced for killing Ram Gupta. Years later, an embittered Khan is released from prison and finds that Gupta is still alive.

programme.title: Don (1978)
programme.desc: Don, a wanted criminal, succumbs to his injuries in a police chase. Things take a turn when Vijay, a lookalike of Don, replaces him and tries to trace the details of his illegal activities.

programme.title: Kohram
programme.desc: A colonel's botched hit leads to a hidden life-until an undercover major tracks him down and joins forces to bring a corrupt minister to justice.

programme.title: Prithviraj Chauhan
programme.desc: The story of the great king who ruled a kingdome in northern India during the latter half of the 12th century.

programme.title: Salaami
programme.desc: Army cadet Vijay uncovers corruption, sparking a fierce battle with the police, led by the vengeful officer Gautam, threatening his career and family.

programme.title: 15Th August
programme.desc: After killing Chaudhry and his son Ram, Nagpal eyes political power as Chief Minister, but Vikram, the surviving son, vows revenge and sets out to destroy him before Independence Day.

programme.title: King Uncle
programme.desc: Industrialist Ashok Bansal's harsh ways push away his siblings. But when orphan girl Munna enters their lives, she slowly softens his tough heart and changes the family.

programme.title: Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, wrongfully imprisoned for seven years, is released and aided by a minister on a covert mission. His quest for justice is intertwined with action, suspense, and his battle against injustice.

programme.title: Avtaar
programme.desc: In a heartwarming twist, a man and his wife flourish against the odds, proving that their bond is stronger than the abandonment of their ungrateful sons. Success awaits them!

programme.title: Insaaf Ki Pukar
programme.desc: Son seeks revenge for father's false accusation by corrupt trio.

programme.title: Loafer
programme.desc: Ravi, an unemployed man known for brawling, is wrongly accused of killing a gangster. Abandoned by his family, he must battle alone to clear his name and prove his innocence.

programme.title: Hatya
programme.desc: Sagar helps a street boy, unaware of the storm ahead. When the boy's mother is found murdered, Sagar becomes the prime suspect, forced to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Taaqat
programme.desc: A group of commandos seek revenge as Brigadier Singha, the Chief of Indian Army, is killed by Dong, a ruthless terrorist.

programme.title: Laawaris
programme.desc: Heera is the illegitimate son of a businessman. When their paths cross, they unknowingly form a bond.

programme.title: Dil Aashna Hai
programme.desc: An aspiring dancer finds herself at odds with three influential women, one of whom she believes is her mother.

programme.title: Dil Ka Kya Kasoor
programme.desc: Arun, a talented singer, gains fame for Seema's lyrics, though they've never met. When they finally meet, their encounter unravels unexpected emotions, leading to a deep connection between them.

programme.title: Mr. India
programme.desc: A poor man takes orphans into his home. After discovering his father's invisibility device, he fights to save his children.

programme.title: Hogi Pyar Ki Jeet
programme.desc: Surjit seeks marriage for his pregnant sister, but is humiliated and killed by Thakur. His dying wish is for his sons to marry Thakur's daughters.

programme.title: Ram Teri Ganga Maili
programme.desc: Narendra marries Ganga, but when he mysteriously disappears, she takes matters into her own hands and sets off on an adventurous quest to find her missing husband.

programme.title: Singh Is Kinng
programme.desc: Happy Singh, a villager goes through a series of misadventures and becomes King of the underworld. He falls in love with Sonia, who hates criminals.

programme.title: Pukar
programme.desc: Major Jaidev and fellow officer rescue politician, capture kidnapper Abhrush.

programme.title: Meet Mere Man Ke
programme.desc: Highly principled Thakur Jagat Pratap falls in love with a girl and wishes to marry her but society plays its dirty hand.

programme.title: Apna Sapna Money Money
programme.desc: Alvarez House in Bombay is a quiet lodging place, until it is suddenly filled with eccentric characters who wreak havoc in the neighborhood.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva earns money for his sister Kusum's marriage. When Kusum gets pregnant with Shakti's child, Shiva vows to murder him.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Kaa
programme.desc: A simple man who gets into the wrong books of a notorious bandit is abducted when he refuses to leave town.

programme.title: Jaan
programme.desc: Police Commissioner Suryadeo Singh hires weapons expert Karan to protect his daughter Kajal. Unaware of Karan's mission, Kajal falls in love with her secret protector.

programme.title: Muqabla
programme.desc: Two brothers find themselves jobs in the police department, when difference arise between them personally and professionally.

programme.title: Kohraam
programme.desc: In Rameshpur, a teacher's murder sparks revenge, as his brother Arjun battles the ruthless Thakur and Kalia to save his family and restore justice.

programme.title: Roop Ki Rani Choron Ka Raja

programme.title: Hameshaa

programme.title: Aag Se Khelenge

programme.title: Kundan

programme.title: Mela
